verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides the building blocks for tightly scoped cards: virtual card issuance, velocity controls to cap transaction count/amount, authorization controls to restrict to a single merchant, and JIT funding that lets your system approve/deny each authorization for an exact amount, plus card-transitions to disable a card after use. However, there's no explicit 'single-use card' primitive or first-class one-time-token feature documented — developers must compose velocity+merchant controls+JIT funding themselves. Missing for 10: a native single-use/one-time card object or flag, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this combination reliably renders a leaked card number worthless after one use.
